text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on foreign investment.
- Qatar Crown Prince Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad to start three-day official visit to Tunisia.
- President Ben Ali instructed transport Minister Sadok Rabeh to use all Tunisian airports to avoid congestion for the annual haj pilgrimage.
- Tunisia and France to boost cooperation on professional training.
- Tunisia aims at self-sufficiency in red meat production.
